## Summary

Head of Data Analytics in energy. I specialise in data reporting, warehousing, governance and end-to-end data solutions. I love ensuring that data teams work on the right things and seize opportunities, all while setting a high bar for quality.

## Experience

### Head of Data Analytics - Ignitis

::: {.cv-meta}
December 2021 – present · Vilnius, Lithuania
:::

Own the data function for Lithuania and Latvia by leading a cross-functional team of data professionals.

- Grew the team from 3 data analysts to 18 people, spanning Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Stewards and Data Scientists.
- Built an internal data platform using Airflow, SQL Server, dbt, and Microsoft Fabric, housing over 80 distinct data sources. 
- Led Power BI adoption by creating actionable reports, reaching all business units, with 520 active users.
- Established a Data Governance programme to increase data quality and define data ownership.
- Created multiple data products on the data platform and on Kubernetes, including:
    - A smart meter API service serving customer-facing systems at subsecond latency;
    - A physical address service used by other internal systems as a source of truth;
    - An internal AI agent helping customer support employees;
    - A reverse ETL service to capture EV station incidents, resulting in an 80% reduction in client complaints.
- Drove GitHub Copilot adoption in the organisation by running workshops and holding a monthly AI Ambassador meetup.

### Senior Data Analyst - Ignitis

::: {.cv-meta}
April 2021 – November 2021 · Vilnius, Lithuania
:::

Served reporting needs as well as advanced analytical use cases, and managed the backlog and work of three analysts.

- Developed ETL pipelines to centralise data and ensure faster turnaround time for new data requests. 
- Segmented the client base by combining multiple data sources and applying PCA, resulting in 4 distinct customer profiles that informed client-facing communication.
- Co-authored a Data Governance standard, paving the way for the role of Data Stewards in the organisation.
- Interviewed potential data analysts to backfill the team. 

### Data Analyst - Ignitis

::: {.cv-meta}
July 2019 – March 2021 · Vilnius, Lithuania
:::

Met reporting and data extraction needs of commercial, finance and wholesale business units using a suite of analytical tools: Power BI, SQL, R, Python and Power Automate.

- Conducted data operations related to energy deregulation, ensuring accurate and timely regulatory submissions and marketing campaigns. 
- Introduced version control for the team's codebase to replace shared-drive files and ensure work does not get lost.
- Built an internal R library to facilitate data extraction tasks and reduce turnaround time.

### Data Analyst - Aon

::: {.cv-meta}
November 2018 – May 2019 · Chicago, United States · Internship sponsored by the Baltic-American Freedom Foundation, Global Claims team
:::

Supported the Global Claims team with data preparation, quality control and
reporting across global claims data using R and Tableau.

Before data, I spent five years doing research on cell morphology at the
Institute of Anatomy, LSMU (2013 – 2018) and co-authored four peer-reviewed papers. Alongside it, I coached high-school students for the
